chunks: He said: "O my people, think. If I have a clear proof from my Lord, and He has bestowed on me His grace, though unknown to you, can we force it upon you when you are averse?"
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Hud say about forcing his message on his people?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Hud (peace be upon him) employs a rhetorical question to demonstrate that divine guidance cannot be forced upon those who are spiritually blind, emphasizing the principle of *ikrah* (compulsion) in faith. Shia exegetes often link this to the broader theme of *bayan* (divine clarification) where the messenger's duty is limited to clear conveyance, leaving the heart's acceptance to individual free will. This underscores the justice of God, who does not burden souls beyond their capacity to receive truth.
